title: Can YOU Beat a 5th Grader's Quiz?
hook: 3 Are You SMARTER Than 5th facts they never teach you
script: Think you're smarter than a 5th grader? Only 1% of adults can ace this three-question trivia test. First up: What is the largest ocean on Earth? Is it the Atlantic, Indian, or Pacific Ocean? Time's ticking! The answer is… the Pacific Ocean! Did you get that right? One point if you did. Next, which planet is known as the "Red Planet"? Is it Mars, Venus, or Jupiter? Don't overthink it! That's Mars, of course! Two questions down, one to go. How are you doing so far? Finally, who wrote "Romeo and Juliet"? Was it Charles Dickens, William Shakespeare, or Jane Austen? This one should be easy! The correct answer is William Shakespeare! So, how many did you get right? Did you prove you're smarter than a 5th grader? Think you're smarter than a 5th grader? Only 1% of adults can ace this three-question trivia test.
